about: Garment presets: the tuned numbers that cut, fit and hide one garment, so a build script names a preset instead of holding them. wardrobe.dress(body, preset) runs tailor -> paint_ease (if any) -> ease -> skin -> hem (if any) -> cover -> spec -> export with them. `cut` is tailor.shirt or tailor.pants; `tailor`, `paint`, `ease`, `hem` and `cover` are that call's keyword arguments (null: the step is skipped); `layer_cover` is cover.compute's arguments for what the garment hides of each garment worn under it; `spec_kind` and `layer` go to spec.build; `colour` is linear RGB; `worn_over` names the presets this one is fitted over when they are worn; `note` says where the numbers came from.

sports_top.name: SportsTop
sports_top.note: Belle's (grungist-creek assets/belle/build_belle.py). Fitted athletic wear: a few millimetres of ease, nothing hanging. Cut sleeveless from the shoulder, its neckline over the top of the bust and its band on the ribs well below the fold under the bust: at the fold itself the skin kept drawn along the hem (cover's 3 cm margin) came through it in Godot. Relaxed over 80 passes to span the cleavage it pulled in over the nipples and fold and let skin through - ease's default 16 iterations kept. Cover agree 0.7, margin 3 cm. A compression garment (improvements 05 5.3): eased 8 mm off the body smoothed over 20 cm of surface, so it no longer traces the nipples; cover follows the cloth up to 3 cm under the skin. It does not `flatten` the bust: flatten needs the body's breast region, and on a body built through character-pipeline follow-through's breast search lands on the jaw, so a preset that asked for it would do nothing there and say nothing - pass flatten={"breast": share} by hand on a body whose breast region is right. Detail limit: over the whole garment the cloth may carry at most 0.06 mm of the skin's own relief (0.02 mm on the smooth sample figure, 0.02 mm on a body embossed with 12 mm bumps where the same cut uncompressed carries 0.10 mm). Settled over 10 cm of its own surface (improvements NEXT 9): on Belle's own heavier bust the unsettled cloth carried 0.171 mm, tucked into the fold under each breast with the fold's skin in front of it, and four lifts over that skin left a faceted shelf and 10 drawn triangles; settled it carries 0.03 mm and nothing needs lifting (7 cm: 0.093 mm and one lift).

shorts_mid_thigh.name: Shorts
shorts_mid_thigh.note: Belle's (build_belle.py). Fitted athletic shorts: a few millimetres of ease, nothing hanging. They sit on the hips and reach a third of the way down the thigh, past the gluteal fold. Cover agree 0.7, margin 3 cm.

compression_shorts.name: CompressionShorts
compression_shorts.note: Compression wear (improvements 05 5.3): skin-tight shorts from the hips to half way down the thigh, 5 mm off the body smoothed (150 Taubin passes) with the buttocks moved a tenth of the way to the membrane over them, so the seat reads held rather than traced. Cover follows the cloth up to 3 cm under the skin. Detail limits: at most 0.06 mm of the skin's relief carried over the whole garment and 0.1 mm over the buttocks (0.01 mm and 0.00 mm on the sample figure; the same cut uncompressed on an embossed body carries 0.09 mm and 0.26 mm).

leggings.name: Leggings
leggings.note: Compression wear (improvements 05 5.3): compression_shorts' fit to the ankle - 5 mm off the smoothed body, the buttocks a tenth of the way to their membrane, no hems. Detail limits as compression_shorts: 0.06 mm over the whole garment, 0.1 mm over the buttocks (0.02 mm and 0.01 mm on the sample figure).

briefs.name: Briefs
briefs.note: Nora's underwear (grungist-creek assets/wardrobe/build_outfits.py), layer 1: 2.5 mm off the skin and nothing hanging, the leg opening rising 40 degrees toward the hip. Cover at wardrobe's defaults.

bra.name: Bra
bra.note: Nora's underwear (build_outfits.py), layer 1: 2.5 mm off the skin and nothing hanging, sleeveless and cut high. Cover at wardrobe's defaults. Nora's build also averages the armpit weights of every shirt with the project's build_person.smooth_weights; dress does not.

shorts.name: Shorts
shorts.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 2, worn instead of trousers: loose cotton shorts that hang, loosening over 7 cm toward the leg openings, with sprung leg hems backstopped against the briefs. Eased at least 3 mm outside the briefs and hiding what it covers of them (4 cm gap, 1.5 cm margin).

trousers.name: Trousers
trousers.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 2, worn instead of shorts: denim to the ankle, the legs loosening over their lower 30 cm, sprung leg hems backstopped against the briefs. Eased at least 3 mm outside the briefs and hiding what it covers of them.

tshirt.name: Tshirt
tshirt.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 3, worn instead of the longsleeve: a jersey T-shirt hanging from the widest point, ease painted at wardrobe's defaults (1 at the hem, 0.3 at the cuffs), 8 hem and 4 cuff bones backstopped against what is under it. Eased at least 3 mm outside the bra and the shorts or trousers and hiding what it covers of each. Nora's build also averages the armpit weights with the project's build_person.smooth_weights; dress does not.

longsleeve.name: Longsleeve
longsleeve.note: Nora's (build_outfits.py), layer 3, worn instead of the T-shirt: wool with sleeves near the wrist, the cuffs eased less than the default (0.2, not 0.3), 8 hem and 4 cuff bones. Eased at least 3 mm outside what is under it and hiding what it covers of each. Nora's build also averages the armpit weights with the project's build_person.smooth_weights; dress does not.
